definition: a series of events that repeats again and again
description: A fairground wall-of-death show at night. A rider in a helmet, goggles and a grey vest races a motorbike sideways round and round the inside of a huge round wooden drum, its headlight shining, smoke and dark tyre marks circling the boards. Above the rim young spectators cheer with raised fists while a man in a flat cap waves a red flag. The view then moves behind the spectators, who clap with raised hands as the rider keeps circling below. Strings of light bulbs and a big wheel glow in the dark.
